description:
Submit a tip! Tips@Midwest-Safety.com

Please consider JOINING for $1 a month. It *really* helps us do original reporting like this. 

CONTACT US:
Complaints? Video submissions? Sponsorships? Collabs? Business inquires? 
Email our board at Tips@Midwest-Safety.com

BE NICE:
The individuals presented in these videos may be suffering from the effects of alcohol, drug abuse, a mental health disorder or simply having a bad day. The videos should NOT be presumed to be representative of their general behavior. Everyone deserves to be treated with respect. 

RIGHT TO BE FORGOTTEN:
Midwest Safety practices the "Right to be Forgotten." If you were the suspect in a lower-level offense, you may email our board to request removal. 
Email: mn.safety.alerts@gmail.com

While James appeared tired at the station and offered little during his brief time with detectives, investigators continued to prepare for trial, anticipating a self-defense claim. However, before trial, there would be one more surprise. Cheryl Pate would ultimately pass away from her injuries, and James Pate, her longtime husband, was charged with first-degree murder. According to the preliminary autopsy findings, Cheryl Pate suffered multiple stab wounds to her neck, face, and upper body. She also showed signs of defensive wounds on her arms and hands, with her ultimate cause of death being listed as multiple sharp force injuries to the neck. While no official photographs of the knife were released, we have receipts that confirmed James purchased a cat-brand folding knife from a local Menards for $15.99 earlier that morning, similar to the one shown here. In the days leading to trial, an ironic twist of fate occurred. The suspect's health rapidly declined. James Pate, now a widow, would end up dying as his heart gave out on October 6, 2025.
